checksums.name: outer_sum16_be
checksums.formula_detail: 16-bit wrapping byte sum stored big-endian: stored_u16_BE at logical 1..2 == (sum of logical bytes 3..70 inclusive) & 0xFFFF. The summed range includes the inner CRC bytes at 3..6. Computed by FUN_0800271c (first read at offset 3 sums 5 bytes, then aligned 8-byte blocks from offset 8). Inclusion of logical byte 71 (zero in samples, summed only if whole block 0x40-0x47 is accumulated) is unresolved. Stored by FUN_08002798 via FUN_080025e4(1,&sum,2) with high byte first. NOTE: offsets are logical EEPROM offsets; file offset = (logical & ~7) | (7 - (logical & 7)) per 8-byte block reversal.

checksums.name: inner_crc32_raw_no_final_xor
checksums.formula_detail: Reflected CRC-32, polynomial 0xEDB88320 (proven by verification; literal _DAT_08016e54 not in C text), init 0xFFFFFFFF, NO final XOR (equals zlib crc32 ^ 0xFFFFFFFF). Per-byte step FUN_08016e3c. Stored little-endian u32 at logical 3..6 (record+0). Covers the 64-byte payload at logical 7..70 inclusive exactly; neighbouring windows do not match.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 engine to/from 0x0D000000 EEPROM; count|0x80000000 enable; IRQ mask/restore; busy-wait. Also used for reads (direction via src/dst args).
EEPROM read one 8-byte cell: serial command bitstream via DMA3, reassembles 4x u16 bit-by-bit.
EEPROM write one 8-byte cell: expands 4x u16 + address to serial bitstream (addr_bits+0x43 halfwords), DMA to 0x0D000000, write-enable, poll bit0, disable.
Verify: readback via 0x080190e8 and compare 4 halfwords; returns 0x8000 on mismatch. Callgraph lists no callers; edges are runtime func_ calls in decompiled text.
Write-enable helper (control register (8<<type) masks, 3-halfword command latch). Exact register unresolved ROM literal.
EEPROM type select/identify; called with 4 at init; returns 0 for accepted types.
EEPROM geometry query type<=3; called with type 2 at init; address-bit count at type_struct+8 drives serial drivers.
Byte-range read over 8-byte cells with read+verify retries (x3).
Byte-range write: per-block read-modify-write + write + verify retries (x3).
Format: block0 byte0=0x17 rest zero, then zero blocks 1..0x3F (512 bytes total).
Outer sum16 computation; returns sum or -1 on read failure.
Record writer: flush record at stride*slot+3, recompute outer sum from EEPROM, store BE sum at logical 1..2. Length arg at call into 0x080025e4 not recovered; 68 inferred+verified.
Record reader: read record from stride*slot+3. Length arg likewise inferred as 68.
Init: type select, geometry, header magic+sum check, format if magic absent. Called with 0x54.
CRC-32 one-byte bitwise step, poly via _DAT_08016e54 (verified as 0xEDB88320 behaviour).
Pack RAM fields into 64-byte payload over 0xFF base, compute inner CRC, flush slot0 via 0x08002798, bracketed by guards 0x08003560/0x08003508.
Load slot0, verify inner CRC (*stored==computed gates all unpacking), unpack bit-fields to RAM. Also calls unrelated 0x080033dc(0x1EA,4) state setter, excluded from save path.
Defaults installer on load failure: zero arrays, set 0x100 entries and 0xF scalar, then 0x08016d6c.
